selection_purpose: Descriptive case selection: identify ten paired logical test-seed blocks that most consistently exhibit v4.8 outperforming both MST+SLT and TemporalGraph across the three frozen scenarios.

pairwise_primary_rule.dominance: success_advantage >= 0 and collision_reduction >= 0 and at least one is strictly positive

secondary_rule.comparison: Apply the frozen metric direction independently for each scenario-baseline-metric pair.
secondary_rule.missing_completion_time: Exclude that completion-time pair from secondary comparable counts; never impute a value.

selection_tiers.A: Primary-dominates both baselines in all three scenarios and has zero primary regressions.
selection_tiers.B: Primary-dominates each baseline in at least two scenarios and has at most one primary regression across all six pairs.
selection_tiers.C: All remaining complete candidates. Included only if fewer than ten A/B candidates exist.

lexicographic_rank.definition: Minimum of the three-scenario dominance counts versus MST+SLT and versus TemporalGraph.

publication_guardrail: The complete 100-seed results and aggregate statistics remain the main evidence. The selected ten are labeled post-hoc descriptive cases and must not be presented as an unbiased estimate or confirmatory significance test.
